name: House Builder (test)
description: A test plugin: builds a small house with walls, a floor, a door, a window, a room, a roof and a note, and reports on the composition of the model.
author: BIMCraft test

functions.label: Build House
functions.description: Builds a house: four walls, a floor, a door, a window, a room, a roof and a text note. One undo step.

at.description: The south-west corner in plan mm; [0, 0] without it

height.description: Wall height in mm; unconnected if given, else up to the level above

room.description: The room's name; Living Room without it

functions.label: Check House
functions.description: Reads the model and answers with a human-readable `report`: levels, elements by category, rooms, walls, openings, floors, roofs, notes, warnings and history. The window shows it. No undo step.
